variants.prompt: Create ONE production-ready decorative frame asset for a museum collectible artwork card. Portrait 2:3 canvas, exactly 1024 x 1536 pixels if possible. Use the reference ONLY for straight-on frame composition, realistic tactile metal detail and portrait proportions; DO NOT copy its Art Deco shapes. New family: French Art Nouveau decorative arts around 1900, elegant sinuous botanical ironwork, slender iris leaves and small ginkgo fans, restrained whiplash curves, a few subtle enamel-like details. ESQUISSE / IRON finish: dark graphite forged iron with cool steel highlights, visibly metallic, not silver, no gold or copper. Symmetrical balanced four-sided frame, orthographic front view, no perspective, entire outer silhouette visible with ~24 pixels clearance to the canvas edges. Dense ornament kept strictly on the border bands: left and right 12% of canvas each; upper and lower 11%. Large EMPTY RECTANGULAR center aperture from x=15% to85%, y=13% to87%, straight inner lip; no leaves or decorative protrusions into this opening. No painting, no object, no glass, no reflection across the aperture. No letters, numbers, logos, badges, symbols or caption plate. Asset isolation requirement: both the entire central opening and all space outside the frame must be PERFECTLY FLAT SOLID VIVID MAGENTA #ff00ff for later chroma-key transparency, with no shadows, texture or lighting on this magenta. No magenta whatsoever in the frame materials. Absolutely no checkerboard. Crisp silhouette, sophisticated photographed metal bas-relief, fine crafted detail readable at card size. ONE iron frame only, not a contact sheet.
